Dear Dr. Markus Grassl,

I am writing to share results from our automated quantum stabilizer search engine (EvoByte) regarding open bounds on codetables.de.

While investigating open parameter sets [[14, 3, 4]] and [[16, 5, 4]], our structured search determined that pure circulant CSS codes cannot achieve distance d >= 4, establishing a structural symmetry limitation.

Additionally, our blind exact SAT solver calibrated successfully on the Gottesman [[8, 3, 3]] code, synthesizing 5 commuting Pauli generators with zero undetected errors of weight 1 or 2 in 0.2 seconds.

Enclosed in this package are the canonical certificate, zero-dependency standalone verifier, reproduction script, and negative bound report for your archives.

All code and certificates are publicly archived:
https://github.com/AlexandreZanata/EvoByte

Sincerely,
Alexandre Zanata
EvoByte Project
https://github.com/AlexandreZanata/EvoByte
